mechanism: Eslicarbazepine is a CYP3A4 inducer that may reduce ginseng bioavailability, while ginseng may have additive CNS effects and both agents have anticonvulsant/pro-seizure modulation properties with conflicting net effects.
action: Monitor seizure control closely; counsel patient on consistent ginseng dosing and timing separate from eslicarbazepine; consider ginseng avoidance in patients with poor seizure control.
